content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

Your primary options for accepting Bitcoin payments are NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway with 300+ integrations, and Stripe, which offers a limited set of payment options but is widely accepted. NOWPayments charges 0.5% on every transaction, making it an attractive alternative to Stripe's 0.5% + $0.25 per transaction fee for US dollars and $5 for international transactions. Additionally, NOWPayments doesn't require KYC or buyer accounts, allowing you to sell to anyone, anywhere in the world.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe doesn't support restricted countries, meaning you'll never be able to sell to customers in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or other countries where it's restricted. NOWPayments, on the other hand, is accessible from anywhere, allowing you to sell to customers in these countries without any issues. This difference is crucial for creators who want to expand their customer base and take advantage of global markets.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments offers faster payment speeds, with transactions typically taking 1-3 minutes to process, compared to Stripe's 3-5 minutes. The fees are also lower, with NOWPayments charging 0.5% on every transaction, while Stripe charges 0.5% + $0.25 per transaction for US dollars and $5 for international transactions. Considering you can sell up to 100 products per month at $97 each, the fee difference retains $921 for you, making NOWPayments a more attractive option.
NOWPayments offers 300+ cryptocurrency integrations, making it a versatile solution for accepting Bitcoin payments.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

NOWPayments allows you to own everything after deployment, giving you full control over your infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is an excellent example of this approach, deploying Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. This stack provides instant delivery, automated order storage, and seamless payment processing, making it an ideal solution for digital creators.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Your choice between NOWPayments and Stripe depends on your specific needs and priorities. If you're looking for a more cost-effective solution with faster payment speeds and no KYC or buyer account requirements, NOWPayments is the better option. On the other hand, if you're already comfortable with Stripe's infrastructure and don't mind the higher fees and restricted country support, you can stick with it.
How do you accept Bitcoin as a payment?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Using NOWPayments can retain you up to $921 per month in fees compared to Stripe.

Additionally, you can explore other products and solutions on our website, such as the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97).
Your Deployment Checklist

To start accepting Bitcoin payments for your ebooks using NOWPayments, follow these steps: 1. Sign up for a NOWPayments account and get your API keys. 2. Configure your checkout page with the NOWPayments widget. 3. Set up automated payment processing using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Integrate your NOWPayments account with your payment gateway. 5. Test your payment flow to ensure smooth transactions.
